kicker.zh: RQ1 · 研究演化 · 第 4 节

title.en: How has agent safety research changed, and which changes hold up under checks?
title.zh: Agent 安全研究发生了怎样的变化，哪些变化经得起核查？

lead.en: Agent safety research increasingly examines how information enters a system, persists, and influences an authorised action. This page follows Section 4 of the paper on the frozen field map (5,378 works first published through 30 September 2026) and keeps the counts, denominators and source records behind each statement.
lead.zh: Agent 安全研究越来越关注信息怎样进入系统、怎样留存、怎样影响授权行动。本页对应论文第 4 节，基于冻结的领域地图（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日首次公开的 5,378 篇论文），并保留每个结论背后的计数、分母和原始记录。

items.en: works in the frozen field map
items.zh: 篇论文进入冻结的领域地图

items.en: share of new works in the three largest themes: 2022 and earlier, 2025 H2, 2026 Q3
items.zh: 前三大主题占新论文的份额：2022 年及以前、2025 下半年、2026 第三季度

p.en: Growth has redistributed attention. Research first spread across a wider range of themes, followed by a partial concentration of recent output. Themes gaining share between 2025 H1 and 2026 H1 include tool execution and coding, injection and skill ecosystems, and memory poisoning.
p.zh: 增长重新分配了注意力。研究先扩散到更多主题，近期产出又部分集中。2025 上半年到 2026 上半年份额上升的主题包括工具执行与编码、注入与技能生态、记忆投毒。

p.en: The strongest shift links information to authorised action. Research on how external information influences authorised action rises from 15% of works published through 2023 (35/236) to 39% in 2026 Q3 (542/1,405); stored information affecting future tasks rises from 8% to 29%; decisions to safe actions from 16% to 31%.
p.zh: 最强的变化把信息与授权行动联系起来。外部信息影响授权行动的研究，从 2023 年及以前的 15%（35/236）升到 2026 年第三季度的 39%（542/1,405）；存储信息影响未来任务的研究从 8% 升到 29%；决策到安全行动从 16% 升到 31%。

note.en: Click a cluster to list its papers. Names were inherited from the v1 map by greatest overlap; the 16 correspondences with Jaccard below 0.6 and three further groups were reviewed and renamed where needed, and mixed groups are marked.
note.zh: 点击星团可列出其论文。名称按最大重叠从 v1 地图继承；Jaccard 低于 0.6 的 16 个对应和另外 3 个组经过复核，必要时改名，混合组单独标出。

p.en: Three research concentrations were selected through structural stability checks and source-based content analysis. Reading them in chronological order connects changes in the information being protected, the location of control and the distribution of agent capabilities. Each record names its work, passage, location and whether it establishes content similarity, a citation or an explicit experimental use.
p.zh: 三个研究集中区通过结构稳定性检验和基于原文的内容分析选出。按时间顺序阅读，可以把被保护的信息、控制所在的位置和 Agent 能力的分布这三方面的变化联系起来。每条记录写明论文、原文段落、位置，以及它所确立的是内容相似、引用联系还是明确的实验使用。

title.en: The 13 half-year structural events that pass the frozen confirmation (Appendix C.2)
title.zh: 通过冻结确认规则的 13 个半年结构事件（附录 C.2）

note.en: Rule frozen on development runs before 200 new confirmatory deletion runs: keep an event when the Wilson 95% lower bound of deletion recurrence is at least 0.5, it recurs in at least 16 of 20 seed runs and in at least 4 of 6 parameter variants. 13 of 82 half-year candidates pass; 8 of 156 quarterly candidates pass.
note.zh: 规则在开发运行中冻结，之后才做 200 次新的确认删减运行：删减复现的 Wilson 95% 下界至少 0.5、20 次换种子中至少 16 次复现、6 个参数变体中至少 4 个复现，事件才保留。82 个半年候选中 13 个通过；156 个季度候选中 8 个通过。

p.en: More defences measure what happens after a response. In the external-information line, the share measuring only text falls from 47% (14/30) in 2025 H1 to 17% (36/206) in 2026 Q3, while the share reaching environment state or consequences rises from 13% (4/30) to 46% (95/206). Stored-information research shows a similar shift.
p.zh: 更多防御测量回答之后发生了什么。外部信息主线中，只测文本的防御从 2025 上半年的 47%（14/30）降到 2026 第三季度的 17%（36/206）；测到环境状态或后果的从 13%（4/30）升到 46%（95/206）。存储信息主线有类似变化。

p.en: Action-oriented evaluation offers a link to embodied safety. The decision-to-action line already measures environment state or consequences in 61% of recorded defences in 2025 H1 (27/44), compared with 64% in 2026 Q3 (105/163).
p.zh: 面向行动的评测连接到具身安全。决策到行动主线在 2025 上半年已有 61% 的防御测量环境状态或后果（27/44），2026 第三季度为 64%（105/163）。

L2 存储信息 → 未来任务

note.en: Deepest evaluated outcome among defences with an identified outcome; labels show identified/all. Categories are not exhaustive. The grey range under each share is the missing-data bound x/(n+m) to (x+m)/(n+m) over recorded and missing defences: not a confidence interval.

p.en: At the final cutoff the frozen best-match Jaccard criterion of at least 0.6 is met by 37 of 61 groups. These contain 4,279 works: 85.6% of the 4,998 clustered works and 81.8% of all 5,233 works entering the graph (the latter denominator includes 235 works left unclustered by consensus).
p.zh: 在最终截点，冻结的最佳匹配 Jaccard ≥ 0.6 标准由 61 个组中的 37 个满足，共 4,279 篇论文：占 4,998 篇成簇论文的 85.6%，占进入图的全部 5,233 篇的 81.8%（后一分母含共识未收入任何组的 235 篇）。

p.en: Small clusters and the limit of early identification. Among 76 newly formed clusters with fewer than 30 works, next-quarter destinations are stable for 44: 20 remain independent, 18 are absorbed and six disperse; the other 32 cannot be assigned a reliable destination. A separately sealed backtest found no stable early-identification advantage over size-matched local random sets; the result is kept as a negative finding.
p.zh: 小星团与早期识别的边界。76 个新形成、少于 30 篇的星团中，44 个的下一季度去向稳定：20 个保持独立、18 个被吸收、6 个分散；其余 32 个无法确定可靠去向。另行封存的回测在规模匹配的局部随机集上没有发现稳定的早期识别优势；这一结果作为负结果保留。
